throughline.zh: 本週涵蓋成熟與先進製程的廠務、載板及測試投資，並記錄台灣與新加坡製造數據、東南亞網路工程及美國貿易措施。
throughline.en: This week paired manufacturing releases from Taiwan and Singapore with fab, substrate and test updates, network infrastructure developments and U.S. trade measures.

title.zh: 晶圓廠、封測廠房及載板擴產
title.en: Fab facilities, packaging sites and substrate expansion

summary.zh: 聯電公告新加坡 P4 三筆交易合計約 367.64 億元。矽品董事會核准 197 億元華亞廠交易，景碩則據報獲通過 601.7 億元高階 ABF 投資計畫。
summary.en: UMC disclosed three Singapore P4 transactions totaling about NT$36.76 billion. SPIL’s board approved a NT$19.7 billion facility purchase, and Kinsus reportedly received clearance for a NT$60.17 billion advanced ABF substrate investment.

title.zh: 美國關稅、出口限制及東南亞貿易協商
title.en: U.S. tariffs, export controls and Southeast Asian trade talks

summary.zh: 美方提出台灣適用最高 15% 的產能過剩 301 關稅，並正式刊登東南亞七家實體列名規則。金融時報報導輝達出貨暫緩，CPTPP 則成立印尼與菲律賓入會工作小組。
summary.en: The U.S. proposed a Section 301 tariff of up to 15% for Taiwan and published a rule adding seven Southeast Asian entities. The Financial Times reported a shipment pause, while CPTPP members set up accession working groups for Indonesia and the Philippines.

title.zh: 台灣與新加坡製造產出及設備需求
title.en: Taiwan and Singapore manufacturing output and equipment demand

summary.zh: 台灣第三季實質 GDP 初步統計年增 14.39%，半導體設備進口額年增 36.04%。台灣 10 月製造業生產年增 31.63%，新加坡同期製造業產出年增 6.1%，兩地各依本地統計口徑。
summary.en: Taiwan’s preliminary Q3 real GDP rose 14.39% and semiconductor equipment import values rose 36.04% in local currency. Taiwan’s October manufacturing output grew 31.63%, and Singapore reported 6.1% growth under its own measure.

title.zh: 東南亞資料中心、海纜與場址設施
title.en: Southeast Asian data centers, subsea cable and site infrastructure

summary.zh: 越泰新海纜動土，設計容量為 600 Tbps。馬來西亞甘孟和波德申案各有動工及機械分包進度，當地另說明機房選址的供水審查。
summary.en: The Vietnam, Thailand and Singapore cable broke ground with 600 Tbps of design capacity. Malaysia had construction and mechanical contracting milestones in Gambang and Port Dickson, alongside water checks for data center siting.

title.zh: 越南與印尼半導體政策及區域工廠投資
title.en: Vietnamese and Indonesian semiconductor policy and regional factory investment

summary.zh: 越南把晶片設計、先進封測與研發資料中心列為 2030 年前的引資重點，並公布海防稀土廠動工。印尼與 OECD 盤點巴淡、西爪哇既有封測布局，台灣則更新電力與減碳政策。
summary.en: Vietnam named chip design, advanced packaging and research data centers as investment priorities and reported a rare earth plant groundbreaking in Hai Phong. Indonesia and the OECD reviewed the back-end ecosystem in Batam and West Java, and Taiwan updated power and emissions measures.
